nodes.name: Chandan Kumar
nodes.summary: Chandan Kumar holds an MSc in Data Science (Distinction) from the University of Hertfordshire, with a thesis on optimizing ensemble learning for diabetes prediction. He has over 8 years of industry experience in AI, ML, and software engineering, including roles at Boeing, Deloitte, EY, and HCL, focusing on cloud-native architectures, generative AI, and agentic pipelines. He has a working paper on 'Governing Responsible and Sustainable AI Across the Lifecycle' and is interested in PhD research at the intersection of AI and regulated industries.
